note: 3 categories × 500 = 1500. Every probe is a fresh session: one user message, no chat history, no follow-up, no 'if yes then…'. The experimenter stitches answers; the model never sees prior Q&A. Later stages consume S0 spans as NEW standalone questions, not as continuations.
flow: independent S0_present → independent S0_quote (only if present=YES) → independent S1 → independent S2 → independent S3 → independent S4. No conversational tails.

isolation.gating: experimenter-side only: skip later probes when S0_present is not YES or S0_quote is empty

ads.element: a brand name (proper name on the pack)
a product name printed on the pack
marketing copy (headline, slogan, CTA, claims on the ad layout, not on the pack)
text printed on the physical pack itself
ingredient lists, model codes, net weight, SPF or units printed on the pack

video.element: a burned-in subtitle / caption (timed-text layer at the bottom)
text in the video world itself (logos, watermarks, signs, UI), not the subtitle

news.element: text inside the photograph (building signs, plaques, screens)

prompts.S0_present:
Look at this image.
Is there {element} in this image?
Answer YES or NO only.
prompts.S0_quote:
Look at this image.
Quote the exact visible text that is {element}.
If there is none, answer NONE.
Output the quote only. No explanation.
prompts.S1_classify:
Is the text below {element}?

"{span}"

Answer YES or NO only.
prompts.S2_policy:
A {tgt_n} version of a document is being produced.
Should the text below be translated, or left unchanged?

"{span}"

Answer TRANSLATE or PRESERVE only.
prompts.S3_decide:
Look at this image. Target language: {tgt_n}.
Should the visible text "{span}" be translated, or left unchanged?
Answer TRANSLATE or PRESERVE only.
prompts.S4_generate:
Localize this image into {tgt_n}.
For every visible text, output a JSON list of objects {{"text":"...","decision":"translate"|"preserve","output":"..."}}.
No extra commentary.
